title: Division Timed Assessments & School Performance Rankings (v0.4.41)
message: Unified timed assessments with local fallback and division-level school performance ranking matrix.
changelog:
🚀 GABAI DIVISION ASSESSMENT & RANKING UPDATE v0.4.41:

• Division School Performance Rankings: Standardized DepEd MPS performance benchmarks, dynamic cohort sorting, and comprehensive learner proficiency breakdowns.
